_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. The balance stopped being all cash this hour. A directed fill at 13:34:59 ET put 124.36 of the 128.90 into 4 UPST at a 31.0899 average, leaving 4.54 in settled cash and nothing unsettled. Total is 127.70 against 128.90 at the last read, the difference being the position marked to market rather than any withdrawal. Deployable is now 4.54, which is below the price of a single share of anything on the candidate list, so the account is effectively fully committed regardless of what the tape offers.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the 8/5 open
entryWatch.why: Dead, and now dead for a second independent reason. AMD is bid 487.15 at 14:22 ET against a 518.58 official close, about -6.1%, a fifth-of-a-percent better than last hour and still deep inside the gap. The sequence is 491.73, 486.55, 482.06, 488.79, 485.92, 487.15 - a name chopping below a gap rather than repairing one, and six reads is enough to call that shape rather than guess at it. The second reason is mechanical and did not exist an hour ago: deployable cash is 4.54, so this setup could not be taken today even if the reaction turned strong in the next ninety minutes.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong but the leader is already extended
entryWatch.why: Conditional on a strong leader, and the leader is -6.1%. Two names printed green this hour - UPST at +1.7% and OKLO back to +0.1% after an hour red - so the 'nothing is green' condition of the 13:22 read has partly lifted, but neither is a leader and a 0.1% print is not a chain to find a laggard in. SMCI, the name this read pointed at, is bid 31.24, about -1.4%. Dead on the same 4.54 deployable that closes the other entry setups.

entryWatch.trigger: A pullback that holds on 8/6 or 8/7, not today's reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Dead as an entry, because the account is already long the name. A directed fill at 13:34:59 ET bought 4 UPST at a 31.0899 average - the reaction-day entry this setup existed to wait past - so the 8/6-8/7 pullback is no longer something this board can act on. Adding to the position on that pullback would be averaging down, which docs/RULES.md lists under 'does not fit', and there is 4.54 to do it with in any case. The setup is closed rather than satisfied: the thing it was waiting for never happened, and the position was taken by another route. UPST is bid 30.84 at 14:22 ET against a 30.32 close, about +1.7%, extending the intraday sequence to 33.81 after-hours, 32.23 open, 32.36, 32.05, 31.63, 31.26, 30.84 - seven reads, six of them consecutively lower, and now 1.39 below its own open bid. The entry sits 0.25 above the current bid as a result. Management of that position, not entry timing, is what the remaining slots are for.

entryWatch.trigger: Leader gapped down, most of the list red, only catalyst is a reaction-day spike
entryWatch.why: The branch the open resolved to and held for four hours, ended at 13:34:59 ET by a directed fill rather than by the tape. It is marked dead because the account is no longer flat and a board that still described itself as standing aside while holding 4 UPST would be contradicting its own exit panel. Recording what the branch was worth while it ran: it was correct on its own terms every hour it was checked, and the reaction-day spike it declined to buy has fallen from a 32.23 open bid to 30.84. It did not fail; it was overtaken. From here this slot's job is the position's levels, and the entry question does not reopen until the account has settled cash again.

candidatesAsOf: 2026-08-05 14:22 ET, live session bids. The Last column is the official 8/4 settled close.
candidatesNote: Bids are live and quoted as bids, never marks. Re-read at 14:22 ET by the fifth mid-session run. This list has stopped being an entry list: deployable settled cash is 4.54, which is below the price of a single share of every name on it, so it is now context for the open UPST position rather than a menu. UPST itself is the one that matters and it leaked a seventh consecutive read to a 30.84 bid, which is 0.25 below the 31.0899 the position was filled at. Last hour's 'all nine red' has partly lifted - OKLO is back to +0.1% and UPST is +1.7% - but neither is a leader and the shape of the tape is unchanged. The four names reporting tonight remain no-fly regardless of where they trade.

candidates.note: Reported. Bid 487.15, about -6.1%, a fraction better than last hour's 485.92 and still deep inside the gap. Sequence 491.73, 486.55, 482.06, 488.79, 485.92, 487.15 - chop below a gap, not repair. Still dead.

Held. The account is long 4 at a 31.0899 average from a 13:34:59 directed fill. Bid 30.84, about +1.7% on the day but 0.25 under the entry. Seventh read, sixth consecutively lower, 1.39 below the 32.23 open bid. Target 37.31, stop 28.60, neither near.
Reports tonight. Any position must be flat by 3:55p. Bid 40.50, about -2.9%, widening from -2.5%.

Earnings 8/7 before the open. A BMO print gaps past every stop, so the window closes on the 8/6 close. Bid 43.38, about +0.1% - back green after one hour red, which is noise around unchanged rather than a signal in either direction.
Earnings 8/11 after the close. Bid 31.24, about -1.4%. Notable now only because 8/11 is also where the open UPST position's five-session time stop lands, so both dates want watching in the same week.
